$Comment: Percent faster block breaking, in whole percent points (10 is +10%), on blocks in the Packed_Soil block family (Server/ZiggfreedCommon/BlockFamilies/Packed_Soil.json, or a block whose own item Tags name Packed_Soil under ZigBlockFamily). ziggfreed-common's gather step adds it to GatherSpeed on such a block, holds the sum at GatherSpeedMax and multiplies the hit's damage by it; the tool still decides what it can break. Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers. Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps.
